paragraphs.text: Korlash is a legendary zombie warrior from Dominaria's past.

Very little is known about Korlash. He is possibly a descendant of Dakkon Blackblade , though he could just as easily be the heir to the actual Blackblade itself. What it is sure of, however, is that he was one of the champions of darkness - like Dakkon and Sol'Kanar - to have wielded the Blackblade, before the legendary sword was recovered by the Cabal and passed into the possession of the demon Belzenlok .
